reviewNote: Recipes have not been reviewed by a dietitian, clinician or food-safety specialist. Nutrition is withheld (null) until per-serving values are calculated from weighed ingredients and reviewed; set nutrition.verified=true only after that review.

meals.name: Jamaican Ackee & Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Heat olive oil in pan
Sauté bell pepper and scallion 2 min
Gently fold in the drained canned ackee and heat through for 2–3 min
Push to the side and scramble the eggs until firm
Mix together, season with pepper
safetyNotes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy
so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

meals.name: Callaloo, Black Bean & Sweet Potato Hash
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Steam diced sweet potato 8–10 min until fork-tender
Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté onion and garlic for 2 min
Add callaloo and black beans, cooking 4–5 min until greens are tender
Fold in sweet potato, season with thyme, and top with pumpkin seeds

meals.name: Spiced Almond Chia & Berry Pudding
instructions: Whisk chia seeds with unsweetened almond milk, vanilla, nutmeg and cinnamon
Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight until thick
Stir in plain Greek yogurt before serving
Top with fresh berries and chopped walnuts

meals.name: Jerk Spiced Tofu Scramble
instructions: Press tofu to remove excess water
Heat oil, sauté vegetables
Add tofu and jerk seasoning
Cook 8-10 min until golden
Stir in nutritional yeast

meals.name: Green Banana, Flax & Walnut Porridge
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened soy or almond milk
instructions: Finely grate the green banana
Bring milk to a gentle simmer in a small pot
Whisk in grated green banana and cook 8–10 min, stirring constantly
Stir in cinnamon, vanilla, ground flaxseed and hemp seeds until thickened
Top with chopped walnuts and serve warm

meals.name: Protein Pumpkin & Almond Pancakes
instructions: Whisk pumpkin puree, eggs, almond flour, flaxseed, baking powder and cinnamon in a bowl
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat
Pour batter and cook about 3 min per side until golden and set in the centre
Serve warm

meals.name: Jamaican Ackee, Green Banana & Black Bean Bowl
ingredients: 1 small green banana, boiled and sliced
instructions: Boil green banana until tender and steam the greens for 3 min
Gently heat the drained canned ackee and black beans in a pan for 2–3 min
Arrange on a plate with sliced avocado and greens
Drizzle with olive oil and season with black pepper
safetyNotes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy
so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

meals.name: Avocado & Saltfish on Whole-Grain Toast
ingredients: 1/4 cup saltfish, soaked overnight (or boiled 15–20 min), rinsed and flaked
instructions: After desalting according to the product instructions, cook the saltfish until a food thermometer reads 145°F (63°C) in the thickest part; then flake it.
Toast bread
Mix avocado with lime juice
Spread on toast
Top with the flaked saltfish and tomato
Season with pepper

meals.name: Greek Yogurt, Papaya & Walnut Parfait
instructions: Layer plain Greek yogurt, papaya cubes and berries in a bowl or glass
Top with chopped nuts and chia seeds
Dust lightly with cinnamon and serve

meals.name: Jamaican Spiced Oat & Flax Porridge
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened soy or almond milk
instructions: Combine rolled oats, milk and cinnamon stick in a small pot
Bring to a gentle boil, then simmer 8–10 min, stirring occasionally
Remove cinnamon stick and stir in flaxseed, chia seeds, nutmeg and vanilla
Top with chopped almonds and serve warm

meals.name: Ackee & Saltfish Salad
instructions: Drain the canned ackee gently so it keeps its shape.
Desalt the saltfish according to the product instructions, then cook until a food thermometer in the thickest part reads 145°F (63°C). Rinse as directed and flake; soaking alone does not cook fish.
In a bowl, combine greens, cucumber, avocado.
Heat olive oil in pan, sauté garlic 30 sec, add ackee and saltfish, warm through (2-3 min).
Place ackee-saltfish mix over greens.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, pepper for dressing, drizzle.
Garnish with scallion.
safetyNotes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy
so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

meals.name: Chicken & Callaloo Egg Muffins
ingredients: ½ cup cooked chicken, shredded (cooked to 165°F / 74°C)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Whisk eggs with unsweetened almond milk, turmeric, pepper.
Stir in chicken, callaloo, bell pepper, scallion.
Spray muffin tin with olive oil.
Pour mixture into 6 muffin cups.
Bake 18–20 min until set and a thermometer in the centre reads 165°F (74°C).
Cool 5 min before removing.

meals.name: Sardine & Vegetable Skillet
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (zucchini, bell pepper, onion)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet.
Sauté garlic and vegetables 5-7 min until tender.
Add sardines with their oil, break into chunks.
Season with Jamaican seasoning, thyme, pepper.
Cook 3-4 min until heated through.
Drizzle with lime juice before serving.

meals.name: Jerk Chicken & Cabbage Stir-fry
instructions: Season chicken with jerk seasoning.
Heat oil in wok or large pan.
Stir-fry chicken 5–6 min until no longer pink and it reaches 165°F (74°C).
Remove chicken, add more oil if needed.
Stir-fry cabbage and carrot 3-4 min.
Return chicken to pan, add water, cook 2 min.
Serve hot.
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Ackee & Tofu Scramble
instructions: Press tofu to remove excess water, crumble.
Heat oil, sauté onion until translucent.
Add tomato, cook 2 min.
Add ackee and tofu, gently stir.
Season with turmeric, thyme, pepper.
Cook 5-7 min until heated through.
safetyNotes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy
so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

meals.name: Callaloo & Egg White Frittata
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Sauté callaloo, bell pepper, garlic in oil 3 min.
Whisk egg whites with nutritional yeast, pepper.
Pour over vegetables in oven-safe dish.
Bake 12–15 min until set and the centre reads 160°F (71°C).
Let cool 5 min before slicing.

meals.name: Protein Power Bowl: Beans & Greens
instructions: Arrange greens in bowl.
Top with beans, corn, avocado.
Sprinkle pumpkin seeds.
Whisk olive oil, lime juice, cumin for dressing.
Drizzle over bowl.

meals.name: Green Protein & Berry Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend spinach, avocado, Greek yogurt, almond milk and protein powder until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with mixed berries, chia seeds and pumpkin seeds.
Enjoy immediately.

meals.name: Jamaican Chicken Salad Wrap
ingredients: ½ cup cooked chicken, shredded (cooked to 165°F / 74°C and chilled)
instructions: Mix chicken with jerk seasoning and lime juice.
Warm tortilla if desired.
Spread Greek yogurt on tortilla.
Layer greens, chicken, avocado.
Roll tightly and slice.

meals.name: Pumpkin & Red Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in pot 5 min.
Add pumpkin, lentils, broth, and spices.
Bring to boil, then simmer 20-25 min.
Blend partially for creamier texture.
Season to taste.

meals.name: Steamed Fish with Okra & Pumpkin
instructions: Season fish with salt and thyme
Place in pot with okra and pumpkin
Add scallion and scotch bonnet
Steam over medium heat 15–20 min until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads 145°F (63°C)

meals.name: Jerk Chicken over Spinach Salad
instructions: Coat chicken with jerk seasoning
Grill or pan-fry about 6 min per side until it reaches 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part
Slice and place over spinach
Add avocado and tomatoes
Dress with lime juice and olive oil
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Curried Chickpea & Callaloo
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil
Add curry powder, toast 1 min
Add chickpeas, coat well
Add callaloo, cook 5 min
Season and serve

meals.name: Jamaican Salmon with Pumpkin & Greens
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Rub salmon with jerk seasoning, thyme, black pepper.
Place salmon on a baking sheet and bake 12–15 min until it flakes easily and reaches 145°F (63°C).
Steam pumpkin cubes 10-12 min until tender.
Heat olive oil in pan, sauté garlic 30 sec, add bok choy and green beans, cook 4-5 min until vibrant.
Plate salmon with pumpkin and greens.
Squeeze lemon over everything.

meals.name: Tuna & Avocado Stuffed Sweet Potato
instructions: Bake sweet potato at 400°F (200°C) for 45–50 min until tender.
Let cool slightly, then slice open.
Mix tuna with avocado, Greek yogurt, lime juice, paprika.
Stuff sweet potato with tuna mixture.
Garnish with scallion and pepper.

meals.name: Jamaican Curry Chicken with Steamed Cabbage
instructions: Season cubed chicken with curry powder, thyme, garlic and ginger.
Heat olive oil in a skillet and brown the chicken with onion for 4–5 min.
Add water, cover and simmer 10–12 min until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
Stir in shredded cabbage and sliced bell pepper and steam 4–5 min until tender-crisp.
Serve hot.
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Curry Goat with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Marinate goat meat with curry powder 30 min.
Heat oil, brown meat on all sides.
Add onion, garlic, ginger, sauté 5 min.
Add water and simmer 1.5–2 hours until the meat is very tender and a food thermometer in the thickest part reads at least 160°F (71°C).
Let the meat rest for at least 3 minutes before serving.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

meals.name: Steamed Fish with Cho-Cho & Carrots
instructions: Season fish with Jamaican seasoning.
Arrange vegetables in steamer basket.
Place fish on top.
Steam 15–20 min until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads 145°F (63°C).
Drizzle with olive oil before serving.

meals.name: Oven-Roasted Chicken with Root Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss vegetables with oil and seasoning.
Arrange chicken and vegetables on baking sheet.
Roast 35–40 min until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.
Serve hot.
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Ground Turkey
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Sauté turkey, onion and garlic until no pink remains and the turkey reaches 165°F (74°C).
Mix with cauliflower rice and tomato sauce.
Stuff bell pepper halves.
Bake 25-30 min until peppers are tender.
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Jerk Pork with Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Marinate pork in jerk marinade 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Roast pork 25–30 min until it reaches 145°F (63°C) in the centre.
Toss vegetables with oil and thyme, roast alongside.
Rest pork at least 3 min before slicing.

meals.name: Callaloo & Saltfish Patties
ingredients: ½ cup saltfish, soaked overnight (or boiled 15–20 min), rinsed and flaked
instructions: Steam callaloo until wilted, squeeze out excess water.
Mix with saltfish, egg, almond flour, thyme, scallion.
Form into patties.
Heat oil and cook patties 3–4 min per side until golden and firm in the centre (160°F / 71°C).
Drain on paper towels.

meals.name: Jamaican Oxtail Stew (Lean)
instructions: Brown oxtail in pot.
Add onion, carrots, garlic, sauté 5 min.
Add broth, browning sauce, thyme, pimento, scotch bonnet.
Simmer 2.5–3 hours until the meat is very tender and a food thermometer in the thickest part reads at least 160°F (71°C).
Let the meat rest for at least 3 minutes before serving.
Remove scotch bonnet before serving.

meals.name: Grilled Snapper with Steamed Veg
instructions: Marinate fillet in lemon, garlic and thyme
Grill about 5 min per side until opaque and it reaches 145°F (63°C)
Steam broccoli and carrots 8 min
Plate with a drizzle of olive oil

meals.name: Jamaican Brown Stew Tofu
instructions: Press and cube tofu, pat dry
Brown in oil until golden
Add onion, garlic, bell pepper, carrot and pimento
Stir in browning and low-sodium soy sauce
Add broccoli and simmer in 1/4 cup water 8–10 min until vegetables are tender-crisp

meals.name: Herb-Crusted Turkey Breast
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C)
Mix herbs, garlic and oil into a paste
Rub all over the turkey breast
Roast until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C), about 30–40 min for a 1 lb breast (longer for larger cuts), steaming the green beans for the last 6–8 min
Rest 5 min before slicing and serve with steamed green beans and lemon
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Mediterranean Shakshuka with Chickpeas
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the bell pepper and garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, crushed tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
Wilted in the baby spinach, make two wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 5-6 minutes until the egg whites and yolks are firm, then serve.
safetyNotes: Cook eggs until whites and yolks are firm (or reach 160°F / 71°C for egg dishes).

meals.name: Mexican Huevos Rancheros Black Bean Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked black beans, rinsed and drained
1 cup chopped romaine or baby spinach
1/2 cup fresh pico de gallo (tomato, onion, cilantro, lime)
instructions: Warm the black beans with cumin in a small pan over medium-low heat for 3-4 minutes.
Heat the avocado oil in a skillet and scramble or fry the eggs until the whites and yolks are firm.
Layer the greens and warm black beans in a bowl, top with the eggs, pico de gallo and sliced avocado.

meals.name: Japanese Tamagoyaki & Miso Tofu Greens
ingredients: 2 cups baby spinach and bok choy
1 tsp white miso paste dissolved in 2 tbsp warm water
instructions: Brush a pan with half the sesame oil over medium heat, pour in the beaten eggs in thin layers and roll into a firm omelet.
In the same pan, warm the remaining sesame oil and sear the tofu cubes for 3 minutes.
Toss in the spinach, bok choy and dissolved miso water; cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Slice the egg roll and serve alongside the miso tofu greens topped with scallion and sesame seeds.

meals.name: Middle Eastern Za'atar Eggs & Tahini Greens
ingredients: 2 cups chopped kale or baby spinach
1 tbsp tahini mixed with 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tbsp water
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the kale for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Crack the eggs into the skillet, sprinkle with za'atar, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until firm.
Arrange the cucumber and cherry tomatoes in a bowl with the cooked kale and eggs, then drizzle with the lemon-tahini dressing.

meals.name: Indian Savory Chickpea & Spinach Cheela
instructions: Whisk the chickpea flour, hemp hearts, turmeric, cumin and 1/2 cup water into a smooth batter.
Fold the chopped spinach, red onion, ginger and cilantro into the batter.
Heat the avocado oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat, pour in the batter to form two thin crepes and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

meals.name: Nordic Seared Salmon & Avocado Breakfast Plate
instructions: Season the salmon fillet with black pepper and lemon juice.
Sear the salmon in a hot skillet with olive oil for 3-4 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the salmon reads 145°F (63°C).
Plate the salmon over the arugula, cucumber ribbons, sliced avocado and capers.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Herb Turkey & Mushroom Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground turkey with thyme and rosemary for 6-7 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reaches 165°F (74°C).
Add the mushrooms, bell pepper and garlic; sauté for 4 minutes until tender.
Fold in the baby spinach until wilted and serve warm.
safetyNotes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: North African Harissa Chickpea & Egg Skillet
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the zucchini and kale for 4 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas, diced tomatoes and harissa paste; simmer for 3 minutes.
Crack the two eggs on top, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites and yolks are firm.

meals.name: Greek Lemon-Oregano Chicken & Quinoa Bowl
ingredients: 1 tsp dried oregano and 1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions: Rub the chicken breast with oregano, half the lemon juice, half the olive oil and black pepper.
Grill or pan-sear over medium heat for 6-7 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
Arrange the greens, cooked quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes and olives in a bowl, top with sliced chicken and drizzle with remaining lemon juice and olive oil.
safetyNotes: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Japanese Seared Salmon & Edamame Bowl
ingredients: 2 cups shredded purple and green cabbage
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 tsp rice vinegar
1 tsp toasted sesame oil and 1 tsp sesame seeds
instructions: Sear the salmon cubes in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece reads 145°F (63°C).
Arrange the shredded cabbage, steamed edamame, cucumber and avocado in a bowl.
Top with the warm seared salmon, drizzle with soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame oil, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
safetyNotes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Mexican Chicken Tinga Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes with 1/2 tsp smoked paprika and cumin
2 tbsp fresh cilantro and 1 lime wedge
instructions: Sauté the onion and garlic in avocado oil over medium heat for 2 minutes, then add the chicken breast, crushed tomatoes, paprika and cumin.
Cover and simmer for 14-16 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
Shred the chicken into the smoky tomato sauce, spoon into crisp romaine leaves with black beans, and top with avocado, cilantro and lime.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Indian Tandoori Chicken & Kachumber Salad
ingredients: 1 tsp garam masala, cumin and turmeric
1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
1 tbsp lemon juice and fresh mint
instructions: Coat the chicken breast in the Greek yogurt, ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin and turmeric.
Roast or pan-sear over medium heat for 6-8 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
Toss the spinach, cucumber, tomato, red onion and mint with lemon juice, and top with the sliced tandoori chicken.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Lebanese Chicken Shawarma & Tahini Salad Bowl
ingredients: 150g skinless chicken breast, sliced into strips
2 cups chopped romaine lettuce and parsley
1 tsp ground cumin, coriander, paprika and cinnamon
1 tbsp tahini whisked with 1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions: Toss the chicken strips with the cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon and olive oil.
Sear in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for 7-8 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest strip of chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
Assemble the romaine, parsley, chickpeas, cucumber, radishes and tomatoes in a bowl, top with the warm chicken and drizzle with lemon-tahini dressing.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Thai Basil Tofu & Green Bean Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 tsp lime juice
instructions: Heat the avocado oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat and sear the tofu cubes for 5-6 minutes until golden.
Add the green beans, bell pepper and garlic; stir-fry for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir in the riced cauliflower, soy sauce and lime juice for 2 minutes, then fold in the fresh Thai basil and serve.

meals.name: Mediterranean Canned Tuna & White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
1 tsp capers and 1 tbsp chopped parsley
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Place the arugula, spinach, cherry tomatoes, red onion and cannellini beans in a large bowl.
Flake the drained canned tuna over the salad and add the capers and parsley.
Drizzle with the lemon juice and extra-virgin olive oil, toss gently and serve.

meals.name: West African Chickpea & Spinach Groundnut Stew
ingredients: 3/4 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
1 garlic clove and 1 tsp fresh ginger, grated
instructions: Warm the avocado oil in a pot over medium heat and sauté the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Whisk in the crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth and natural peanut butter until smooth.
Add the chickpeas and simmer for 8-10 minutes until rich and fragrant.
Fold in the chopped spinach for 2 minutes until wilted and serve warm.

meals.name: Mediterranean Baked Cod with Tomatoes & Olives
ingredients: 1 tsp dried oregano and 1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Arrange the zucchini, cherry tomatoes, olives, capers and garlic in a baking dish, and place the cod fillet on top.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, and season with oregano and black pepper.
Bake for 14-16 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the cod reads 145°F (63°C).
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Korean Ginger-Soy Salmon with Bok Choy
ingredients: 1 cup shiitake or cremini mushrooms, sliced
1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
1 scallion, sliced, and 1 tsp sesame seeds
instructions: Whisk together the soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil.
Sear the salmon fillet in a non-stick skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes per side, brushing with half the ginger-soy glaze.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the salmon reads 145°F (63°C).
In the same skillet, sauté the mushrooms and bok choy with the remaining glaze for 4 minutes until tender-crisp, then plate with the salmon.
safetyNotes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Mexican Lime-Cilantro Fish Fajita Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 green and 1/2 red bell pepper, sliced
1 tsp ground cumin and chili powder
1 tbsp lime juice, fresh cilantro and 1 tsp avocado oil
instructions: Rub the fish fillet with cumin, chili powder and half the lime juice.
Sauté the bell peppers and onion in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes, then push to the side and add the fish fillet.
Cook the fish for 3-4 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads 145°F (63°C).
Warm the riced cauliflower and black beans, top with the fish and peppers, and garnish with avocado, cilantro and lime.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Indian Chana Palak (Spinach & Chickpea Masala)
ingredients: 3/4 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
2 tbsp pumpkin seeds or hemp hearts
1 garlic clove and 1 tsp fresh ginger, minced
1 tsp garam masala, ground cumin and turmeric
instructions: Heat the avocado oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the garam masala, cumin, turmeric and crushed tomatoes; simmer for 4 minutes.
Stir in the chickpeas and baby spinach, cooking for 6-8 minutes until the spinach is tender and coated in the spiced tomato gravy.
Top with pumpkin seeds or hemp hearts and serve warm.

meals.name: Middle Eastern Turkey Kofta & Roasted Eggplant
ingredients: 1 cup chopped cucumber and tomato salad
2 tbsp finely chopped fresh parsley and mint
1 tsp ground cumin, coriander and cinnamon
1 tbsp tahini mixed with 1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the cubed eggplant with olive oil and roast on a baking sheet for 20 minutes until golden.
Mix the ground turkey with the garlic, parsley, cumin, coriander and cinnamon, and shape into 3 oval koftas.
Bake or pan-sear the turkey koftas for 12-14 minutes until a food thermometer in the centre of the turkey reads 165°F (74°C).
Serve the turkey koftas with the roasted eggplant, cucumber-tomato salad and lemon-tahini drizzle.
safetyNotes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Moroccan Lemon & Olive Chicken Tagine
ingredients: 1 tsp ground ginger, cumin, turmeric and cinnamon
1/2 cup low-sodium vegetable broth and 1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh cilantro
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat and brown the chicken cubes with onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric and cinnamon for 4 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth, carrot, zucchini, olives and lemon juice; cover and simmer for 14-16 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve warm.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Chinese Garlic Chicken & Broccoli Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp fresh ginger, minced
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1/4 cup water
1 tsp toasted sesame oil and 1 tsp sesame seeds
instructions: Stir-fry the sliced chicken in a hot wok or skillet over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes.
Add the broccoli, snap peas, mushrooms, garlic, ginger and water; cover and steam-fry for 4 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and sesame oil and cook until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads 165°F (74°C), then top with sesame seeds.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Tuscan Herbed Chicken with White Beans & Kale
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
1 tsp dried rosemary, thyme and oregano
instructions: Season the chicken breast with rosemary, thyme, oregano and black pepper, and sear in olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes per side.
Add the garlic, diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, cannellini beans and kale around the chicken; cover and simmer for 6-8 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F (74°C) before serving.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Turkish Menemen with Ground Turkey & Herbs
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and brown the ground turkey with onion and green bell pepper for 6 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the tomatoes, paprika and oregano and simmer for 3 minutes until juicy.
Pour in the beaten eggs, stir gently until the eggs are fully set and firm, and top with fresh parsley.
safetyNotes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Persian Kuku Sabzi (Fresh Herb & Walnut Frittata)
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped fresh parsley, cilantro and dill
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the turmeric and black pepper, then fold in the chopped herbs, scallions, spinach and walnuts.
Warm the olive oil in a small non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and pour in the herb-egg mixture.
Cover and cook for 6-7 minutes, then flip and cook for 3 more minutes until firm throughout.

meals.name: Japanese Chawanmushi-Style Savory Egg & Shiitake Bowl
instructions: Whisk the eggs gently with the vegetable broth and soy sauce until smooth.
Arrange the cubed tofu, shiitake mushrooms and baby spinach in a heatproof bowl and pour the egg mixture over them.
Place the covered bowl in a steamer basket over simmering water and steam for 12-14 minutes until the egg custard is set in the centre, then garnish with scallion.

meals.name: Korean Soft Tofu & Egg Morning Stew (Sundubu)
ingredients: 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth, garlic, soy sauce, zucchini and mushrooms to a simmer in a small pot for 4 minutes.
Spoon in the soft tofu in large chunks and add the baby spinach.
Crack the egg into the simmering broth, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until the egg is firm, then finish with sesame oil and scallion.

meals.name: Spanish Spinach, Chickpea & Garlic Egg Skillet
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and gently toast the sliced garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the smoked paprika and chickpeas and cook for 3 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Toss in the fresh spinach until wilted, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until firm.

meals.name: Mexican Machaca-Style Shredded Chicken & Egg Scramble
ingredients: 1/4 green bell pepper and 1/4 onion, diced
instructions: Heat the avocado oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the shredded chicken with onion and bell pepper for 6-7 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the chicken reaches at least 165°F (74°C).
Add the diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes, then pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until firm.
Serve topped with sliced avocado and fresh cilantro.
safetyNotes: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Indian Masala Egg Bhurji with Spinach
ingredients: 1/2 tsp ground cumin, turmeric and coriander
instructions: Warm the avocado oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the red onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the cumin, turmeric, coriander and diced tomato; cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in the baby spinach until wilted, pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until fully cooked and firm, then garnish with cilantro.

meals.name: Indian Spiced Tofu Bhurji & Bell Pepper Scramble
ingredients: 1/2 cup green peas or shelled edamame
1 tsp grated ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
1/2 tsp ground turmeric, cumin and garam masala
1 tsp avocado oil and fresh cilantro
instructions: Heat the avocado oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the ginger, garlic and bell pepper for 3 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, cumin, garam masala, crumbled tofu and green peas; cook for 5 minutes.
Fold in the chopped spinach for 2 minutes until wilted and top with fresh cilantro.

meals.name: Lebanese Ful Medames (Warm Fava & Chickpea Bowl)
ingredients: 3/4 cup cooked fava beans and chickpeas, rinsed
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Warm the fava beans and chickpeas with garlic, cumin and 2 tbsp water in a small pot for 5 minutes, lightly mashing half the beans.
Transfer to a bowl and top with the diced cucumber, tomato, parsley and hard-boiled egg halves.
Drizzle with lemon juice and extra-virgin olive oil.

meals.name: Ethiopian Spiced Red Lentil & Collard Green Hash
ingredients: 2 cups finely chopped collard greens or kale
1/4 red onion and 1 garlic clove, minced
1/2 tsp berbere spice or smoked paprika and cumin
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion, garlic and collard greens with a splash of water for 5 minutes until tender.
Stir in the berbere spice and cooked red lentils and warm through for 3 minutes.
Make a well in the centre, crack in the egg, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until firm.

meals.name: French Herbes de Provence Mushroom & Spinach Omelet
ingredients: 1/2 tsp herbes de Provence (thyme, rosemary, marjoram)
instructions: Heat half the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat and sauté the mushrooms and spinach with herbes de Provence for 4 minutes; transfer to a plate.
Whisk the eggs, egg whites and chives together, warm the remaining oil in the skillet and pour in the eggs.
Cook until set, spoon the mushroom-spinach filling onto one half, fold over and cook for 1 more minute until firm.

meals.name: British Kipper-Style Baked Trout & Tomato Plate
ingredients: 1 tbsp lemon juice and chopped parsley
instructions: Brush the trout fillet, tomato halves and mushrooms with olive oil and black pepper.
Pan-sear or broil for 4-5 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the trout reads 145°F (63°C).
Wilt the baby spinach in the warm pan for 1 minute and serve alongside the trout, tomatoes and mushrooms with lemon juice.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: American Southwest Turkey, Black Bean & Avocado Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced tomatoes and bell pepper
1/2 tsp ground cumin and chili powder
instructions: Brown the ground turkey with cumin and chili powder in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Add the kale, black beans, tomatoes and bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes until the kale is tender.
Transfer to a bowl and top with diced avocado.
safetyNotes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Brazilian Sardine, Egg & Tomato Savory Skillet
ingredients: 1 can sardines in water or olive oil (about 120g), drained
1 cup chopped collard greens or spinach
1 tbsp lime juice and 1 tsp olive oil
instructions: Sauté the onion, tomato and collard greens in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes.
Flake in the drained canned sardines and warm through for 2 minutes.
Crack in the eggs, scramble gently until the eggs are firm, and finish with lime juice and fresh cilantro.

meals.name: Peruvian Quinoa, Black Bean & Egg Breakfast Bowl
ingredients: 1 tbsp lime juice and fresh cilantro
instructions: Warm the quinoa, black beans and baby spinach in a skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes until the spinach wilts.
In the same skillet, heat the olive oil and cook the eggs until the whites and yolks are firm.
Assemble in a bowl and top with sliced avocado, lime juice and cilantro.

meals.name: Vietnamese Lemongrass Chicken & Greens Morning Soup
ingredients: 2 cups bok choy and bean sprouts
1.5 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth
1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 stalk bruised lemongrass (or 1 tsp lime zest)
2 tbsp fresh cilantro, mint and Thai basil
instructions: Bring the broth, ginger and lemongrass to a simmer in a saucepan for 5 minutes.
Add the sliced chicken breast and simmer for 6-7 minutes until a food thermometer in the chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Add the bok choy and bean sprouts for 2 minutes until tender-crisp, then ladle into a bowl with fresh herbs and lime.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Thai Ginger-Garlic Chicken & Bok Choy Rice-Free Congee
ingredients: 1 cup low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth
1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Simmer the riced cauliflower, ginger, garlic and broth in a pot over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Stir in the ground chicken, breaking it up fine, and simmer for 6-7 minutes until a food thermometer reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Fold in the chopped bok choy for 2 minutes until tender, then top with sesame oil, scallion and cilantro.
safetyNotes: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Greek Yogurt, Hemp Seed, Walnut & Blueberry Bowl
instructions: Spoon the plain Greek yogurt into a chilled bowl.
Top evenly with the fresh blueberries, hemp hearts, chopped walnuts and ground flaxseed.
Dust with ground cinnamon and serve immediately.

meals.name: Moroccan Spiced Lentil & Poached Egg Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked brown or green lentils
1/2 tsp ground cumin, coriander and cinnamon
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the diced tomatoes, cumin, coriander and cinnamon for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cooked lentils and baby spinach until wilted.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes until firm, then top with cilantro.

meals.name: Italian Zucchini, Tomato & Basil Frittata
instructions: Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe or covered skillet over medium heat and sauté the zucchini and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes and arugula for 1 minute, then pour in the beaten eggs and egg whites.
Cover and cook on medium-low heat for 6-7 minutes until completely set in the centre, then top with fresh basil.

meals.name: West African Black-Eyed Pea & Spinach Scramble
ingredients: 1/2 roma tomato and 1/4 red onion, diced
1/2 tsp grated fresh ginger and smoked paprika
instructions: Heat the avocado oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the red onion, tomato and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the black-eyed peas, smoked paprika and spinach; cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Push the greens to one side, scramble the eggs until firm, then toss together and serve.

meals.name: Scandinavian Dill Cod & Poached Egg over Greens
ingredients: 2 cups steamed asparagus spears and baby spinach
instructions: Season the cod fillet with dill, lemon juice and black pepper, and pan-sear in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes per side.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the cod reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Cook the egg until the white and yolk are firm, and serve over the steamed asparagus and spinach alongside the cod.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Thai Larb Gai (Herbed Minced Chicken Lettuce Cups)
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh mint, cilantro and Thai basil
1.5 tbsp fresh lime juice and 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce
instructions: Cook the ground chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat with 2 tbsp water for 6-7 minutes, breaking it up fine.
Check with a food thermometer that the ground chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Toss the warm chicken off the heat with the lime juice, soy sauce, shallot and fresh herbs.
Spoon into crisp butter lettuce leaves with cucumber slices and top with crushed peanuts.
safetyNotes: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Korean Tofu & Mushroom Cauliflower Bibimbap Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup baby spinach and 1/2 cup bean sprouts
1/2 cup sliced shiitake mushrooms and 1/2 julienned carrot
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 garlic clove, minced
1 tsp toasted sesame oil and 1 tsp sesame seeds
instructions: Pan-sear the tofu cubes in half the sesame oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until golden.
Sauté the riced cauliflower, mushrooms, carrot, bean sprouts and spinach with garlic and soy sauce for 4-5 minutes.
Fry the egg in the remaining oil until the white and yolk are firm, then arrange over the cauliflower bowl with the tofu and sesame seeds.

meals.name: Vietnamese Lemongrass Tofu & Cabbage Salad (Goi Ga Style)
ingredients: 2.5 cups finely shredded green and purple cabbage
1/2 cup fresh mint, cilantro and Thai basil
2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Sear the tofu strips in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until crisp and golden.
Toss the shredded cabbage, carrot, cucumber and fresh herbs with the lime-garlic dressing.
Top with the warm crispy tofu and chopped roasted peanuts.

meals.name: Spanish Garlic Shrimp & White Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked white cannellini beans, rinsed
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the sliced garlic and smoked paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until opaque and cooked through.
Toss the spinach, arugula, white beans and roasted red pepper with lemon juice, and top with the warm garlic shrimp.

meals.name: Italian Tuscan Tuna, Chickpea & Arugula Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
1 tbsp red wine vinegar or lemon juice
1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh basil
instructions: Combine the baby arugula, chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, sliced celery and torn basil in a bowl.
Top with the flaked canned tuna.
Drizzle with the lemon juice and extra-virgin olive oil, season with black pepper and toss to coat.

meals.name: Mexican Grilled Fish & Jicama Cabbage Slaw Bowl
ingredients: 2 cups shredded cabbage and julienned jicama (or radish)
1/3 cup cooked pinto or black beans, rinsed
2 tbsp plain unsweetened Greek yogurt whisked with 1 tbsp lime juice
1/2 tsp chili powder and ground cumin
1 tsp avocado oil and fresh cilantro
instructions: Rub the fish fillet with chili powder, cumin and black pepper, and sear in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Toss the shredded cabbage, jicama and cilantro with the lime-yogurt dressing, and top with the black beans, flaked fish and avocado.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Peruvian Lime-Poached Halibut & Avocado Bowl
ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh lime juice and 1/4 cup vegetable broth
instructions: Simmer the fish cubes gently in the vegetable broth and half the lime juice in a covered skillet for 5-6 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Arrange the romaine lettuce, steamed sweet potato, red onion and avocado in a bowl, top with the fish and drizzle with remaining lime juice and cilantro.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Brazilian Collard Greens, Black Bean & Grilled Chicken Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced tomato, onion and vinegar salsa (vinagrete)
instructions: Season the chicken breast with half the garlic, cumin and black pepper, and grill or sear for 6-7 minutes per side.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Sauté the ribboned collard greens with the remaining garlic in olive oil for 3 minutes until bright green and tender.
Serve the sliced chicken over the collard greens and warm black beans, topped with the fresh tomato vinagrete.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Indian Dal Palak (Spiced Red Lentil & Spinach Soup)
ingredients: 1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
1/2 tsp ground turmeric, cumin seeds and garam masala
1.5 cups water or low-sodium vegetable broth
1 tsp avocado oil and 1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions: Simmer the rinsed red lentils with turmeric and broth in a saucepan for 14-15 minutes until soft.
In a small skillet, warm the avocado oil and sauté the cumin seeds, onion, garlic, ginger and tomato with garam masala for 4 minutes.
Stir the spiced tomato mixture and baby spinach into the lentils, simmer for 2 minutes until wilted, and finish with lemon juice.

meals.name: Indian Spiced Chickpea, Cucumber & Mint Chana Salad
ingredients: 3/4 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
2 tbsp plain unsweetened Greek yogurt or tahini
1 cup diced cucumber and roma tomato
1/2 tsp roasted ground cumin and chaat masala (or black pepper)
1 tbsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp fresh cilantro and mint
instructions: Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, red onion, spinach, cilantro and mint in a bowl.
Whisk the lemon juice, roasted cumin and Greek yogurt (or tahini) together.
Toss the salad with the spiced dressing and serve chilled or at room temperature.

meals.name: Turkish Grilled Chicken Skewers (Tavuk Sis) & Shepherd Salad
ingredients: 1 cup diced cucumber, tomato and green bell pepper
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Toss the chicken cubes with Greek yogurt, paprika, oregano and garlic.
Grill or sear in a hot skillet for 7-8 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest cube reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Toss the cucumber, tomato, bell pepper, red onion and parsley with lemon juice and olive oil, and serve alongside the chicken.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Persian Herb, Lentil & Chicken Soup (Ash-e Jo Twist)
ingredients: 2 cups chopped spinach, parsley, cilantro and dill
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp olive oil
instructions: Sauté the onion, garlic, turmeric and cumin in olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add the diced chicken breast, cooked lentils and broth; cover and simmer for 12-14 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the chicken reaches at least 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the chopped spinach and fresh herbs for 3 minutes until tender, and finish with lemon juice.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Ethiopian Chicken Tibs with Garlic Collard Greens (Gomen)
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp fresh ginger, minced
1 tsp berbere spice or paprika, cumin and cardamom
instructions: Steam or braise the collard greens with half the garlic and 1/4 cup water in a covered pan for 8 minutes until tender.
In a skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and sear the chicken cubes with red onion, remaining garlic, ginger and berbere spice for 7-8 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C), squeeze lemon juice over top, and serve with the collard greens.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Moroccan Spiced Carrot, Chickpea & Grilled Turkey Salad
ingredients: 1/2 tsp ground cumin, cinnamon and paprika
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Rub the turkey breast cutlet with cumin, cinnamon, paprika and black pepper, and pan-sear in olive oil for 5-6 minutes per side.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Toss the spinach, arugula, carrot and chickpeas with lemon juice, top with sliced turkey and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds.
safetyNotes: Cook turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: French Salad Niçoise with Seared Salmon & Green Beans
ingredients: 1 cup fresh green beans, steamed tender-crisp
1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Sear the salmon fillet in a non-stick skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Arrange the salad greens, steamed green beans, cherry tomatoes, olives and hard-boiled egg on a plate.
Top with the warm salmon fillet and drizzle with the whisked Dijon, lemon juice and olive oil dressing.
safetyNotes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Nordic Open-Faced Sardine, Egg & Cucumber Rye Plate
ingredients: 1 can sardines in water or olive oil (about 120g), drained
1 thin slice 100% whole-grain sprouted rye bread, toasted
1 tbsp fresh dill and 1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions: Layer the baby arugula, cucumber slices, drained canned sardines and sliced hard-boiled egg over the toasted rye slice and alongside on the plate.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the sardines and garnish generously with fresh dill and radish slices.

meals.name: American California Turkey, Avocado & Greens Cobb Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes and 1/2 cucumber, diced
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Season the turkey breast with black pepper and garlic powder, and grill or pan-sear for 5-6 minutes per side.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C), then slice.
Arrange the romaine, watercress, tomatoes, cucumber, avocado, hard-boiled egg and turkey in a bowl, and drizzle with whisked vinegar, Dijon and olive oil.
safetyNotes: Cook turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Chinese Sesame-Ginger Tofu & Cabbage Slaw
ingredients: 2.5 cups shredded Napa cabbage and purple cabbage
1 tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp toasted sesame oil and 1 tbsp sliced almonds
instructions: Sear the cubed tofu in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until golden on all sides.
Whisk together the rice vinegar, soy sauce, grated ginger and toasted sesame oil.
Toss the shredded cabbage, carrot, scallions and edamame with the dressing, and top with the warm tofu and sliced almonds.

meals.name: Greek Grilled Halibut & Artichoke Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup marinated artichoke hearts (in water), quartered
2 cups chopped romaine and baby spinach
1/2 cup cherry tomatoes and cucumber, diced
1 tsp dried oregano and 1 garlic clove, minced
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Season the fish fillet with oregano, garlic, half the lemon juice and olive oil.
Grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Arrange the romaine, spinach, artichoke hearts, tomatoes and cucumber on a plate, top with the fish and drizzle with remaining lemon juice.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Nordic Dill-Baked Salmon with Roasted Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1.5 cups Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the halved Brussels sprouts and asparagus with 1 tsp olive oil and roast on a sheet pan for 10 minutes.
Place the salmon fillet on the sheet pan, rub with the remaining olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and fresh dill.
Roast for 12-14 minutes more until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the salmon reads at least 145°F (63°C).
safetyNotes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Greek Lemon-Garlic Haddock with Braised Greens (Horta)
ingredients: 3 cups chopped dandelion greens, Swiss chard or spinach
instructions: Sauté half the garlic in 1 tsp olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat, add the chopped greens and a splash of water, and braise for 5 minutes until tender.
Season the haddock fillet with oregano, remaining garlic and lemon juice, and sear in a pan for 4 minutes per side.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the fish reads at least 145°F (63°C), then serve over the braised lemon greens.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Spanish Pollo al Ajillo (Garlic-Herb Chicken) with Zucchini
ingredients: 170g skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
1.5 cups sliced zucchini and roasted red bell peppers
1 bay leaf and 1/2 tsp fresh thyme
1/3 cup low-sodium vegetable broth and 1 tbsp lemon juice
1.5 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and chopped parsley
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the sliced garlic for 2 minutes until lightly golden.
Add the chicken pieces, bay leaf and thyme; sear for 6-7 minutes until browned.
Add the zucchini, red peppers, broth and lemon juice; simmer for 5-6 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Fold in the spinach and parsley and serve.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Italian Chicken Cacciatore with Mushrooms & Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, minced, and 1 tsp Italian herbs
1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh basil
instructions: Sear the chicken breast in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes per side.
Add the onion, bell pepper, mushrooms and garlic around the chicken and cook for 4 minutes.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, Italian herbs, capers and olives; cover and simmer for 10-12 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Garnish with fresh basil and serve.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Turkish Baked Eggplants with Spiced Ground Turkey
ingredients: 1/4 onion and 1/2 green pepper, finely diced
1/2 tsp ground cumin, paprika and cinnamon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Score the eggplant halves, brush with half the olive oil and roast for 18 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, brown the ground turkey with onion, green pepper, garlic, cumin, paprika and cinnamon in a skillet for 7 minutes, then stir in the tomatoes.
Spoon the turkey filling over the eggplant halves and bake for 8 minutes until a food thermometer in the centre of the turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Top with fresh parsley and serve.
safetyNotes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Persian Ghormeh Sabzi (Fresh Herb, Kidney Bean & Chicken Stew)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked red kidney beans, rinsed
2.5 cups finely chopped parsley, cilantro, spinach and scallions
1/2 tsp ground turmeric and fenugreek leaves
1 cup low-sodium vegetable broth and 1.5 tbsp fresh lime juice
instructions: Sauté the finely chopped herbs and spinach in 1 tsp olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until dark green and fragrant.
In a pot, brown the chicken cubes with onion, garlic and turmeric in the remaining oil for 5 minutes.
Add the sautéed herbs, kidney beans, broth and lime juice; cover and simmer for 18-20 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C) before serving.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Lebanese Baked Kibbeh-Spiced Turkey & Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 2 tbsp fine bulgur wheat or ground flaxseed, soaked in water
1/4 onion, grated, and 2 tbsp chopped fresh mint and parsley
1/2 tsp ground allspice, cinnamon and cumin
1.5 cups diced cucumber, tomato and radish salad
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Mix the ground turkey, soaked bulgur (or flaxseed), grated onion, mint, allspice, cinnamon and cumin.
Press into a small baking dish, score into diamonds, brush with olive oil and bake for 20-22 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the centre of the turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Serve alongside the crisp cucumber, tomato and radish salad dressed with lemon juice.
safetyNotes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Ethiopian Doro Wat Style Spiced Chicken & Red Lentils
ingredients: 160g skinless chicken breast or thigh, cubed
1 tsp grated ginger and 2 garlic cloves, minced
1 tsp avocado oil and 3/4 cup vegetable broth
instructions: Cook the finely diced red onion in avocado oil with a splash of water over medium-low heat for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the garlic, ginger and berbere spice for 1 minute, then add the chicken and vegetable broth.
Cover and simmer for 16-18 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Nestle the hard-boiled egg into the sauce and serve alongside the red lentils and steamed collard greens.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Moroccan Spiced Turkey & Chickpea Harira Stew
ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas and 1/4 cup cooked green lentils
1 cup crushed tomatoes and 1 cup vegetable broth
1 tsp grated ginger, turmeric, cumin and cinnamon
1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro and parsley
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp olive oil
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat and brown the ground turkey with onion, celery and ginger for 6-7 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reaches at least 165°F (74°C).
Add the turmeric, cumin, cinnamon, crushed tomatoes, broth, chickpeas and lentils; simmer for 12-15 minutes.
Stir in the fresh cilantro, parsley and lemon juice before serving.
safetyNotes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: West African Ginger-Peanut Chicken & Kale Stew
ingredients: 2 cups chopped kale or collard greens
1/2 cup crushed tomatoes and 3/4 cup vegetable broth
1/4 onion, 1 garlic clove and 1 tsp fresh ginger, minced
instructions: Sear the chicken cubes with onion, garlic and ginger in avocado oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Whisk in the crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth and natural peanut butter, then cover and simmer for 14-16 minutes.
Stir in the chopped kale for the last 4 minutes of cooking.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C) before serving.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Indian Tandoori Salmon with Roasted Cauliflower & Spinach
ingredients: 1 tsp garam masala, ground cumin, coriander and turmeric
1 tsp grated ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp avocado oil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the cauliflower florets with avocado oil and a pinch of turmeric and roast on a sheet pan for 10 minutes.
Coat the salmon fillet with Greek yogurt, ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin and coriander, and place on the sheet pan.
Roast for 12-14 minutes more until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the salmon reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Serve over fresh baby spinach with a squeeze of lemon juice.
safetyNotes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Indian Chicken Tikka Skillet with Peppers & Fenugreek Greens
ingredients: 1/2 bell pepper and 1/4 red onion, cut into petals
1 tsp garam masala, cumin, paprika and dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi)
1 tsp grated ginger, 1 garlic clove and 1 tsp avocado oil
instructions: Marinate the chicken cubes in Greek yogurt, ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin and paprika.
Sear the chicken, bell pepper and onion in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Add the tomato purée, fenugreek leaves and spinach; simmer for 6-8 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Japanese Miso-Glazed Cod with Baby Bok Choy & Edamame
ingredients: 1 tsp rice vinegar and 1 tbsp water
instructions: Whisk together the white miso paste, rice vinegar, grated ginger, sesame oil and water.
Brush the cod fillet with the miso glaze and bake at 400°F (200°C) or pan-sear over medium heat for 10-12 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the cod reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Steam the baby bok choy and edamame for 4 minutes and serve alongside the miso-glazed cod.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Thai Lemongrass Poached Snapper with Bok Choy & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1.5 cups baby bok choy and 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms
1 stalk bruised lemongrass and 1 tsp grated ginger
1 tbsp fresh lime juice and 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce
2 tbsp fresh cilantro and Thai basil
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth, lemongrass, ginger, garlic and mushrooms to a gentle simmer in a deep skillet for 5 minutes.
Nestle the snapper fillet and baby bok choy into the fragrant broth, cover and poach for 7-9 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Stir in the lime juice and soy sauce, and garnish with fresh cilantro and Thai basil.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: Vietnamese Ginger-Scallion Chicken with Chayote & Greens
ingredients: 1.5 cups Chinese broccoli or baby spinach
1 tbsp finely julienned fresh ginger and 2 garlic cloves
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1/4 cup water
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and stir-fry the ginger, garlic and chicken slices for 5 minutes.
Add the chayote squash, Chinese broccoli, soy sauce and water; cover and cook for 5-6 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest slice of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C), toss with the scallions and serve.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Mexican Smoky Turkey, Black Bean & Zucchini Enchilada Skillet
ingredients: 1 tsp chili powder, ground cumin and oregano
1/4 avocado, sliced, and 2 tbsp fresh cilantro
instructions: Heat the avocado oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground turkey with onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin and oregano for 6-7 minutes.
Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Stir in the cubed zucchini, black beans and fire-roasted tomatoes; cover and simmer for 6-8 minutes until the zucchini is tender.
Top with sliced avocado and fresh cilantro.
safetyNotes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Peruvian Aji-Style Herb Chicken with Cauliflower & Olives
ingredients: 1/4 onion, 2 garlic cloves and 1/2 yellow bell pepper, blended with 1/4 cup vegetable broth
1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh cilantro
instructions: Sear the chicken slices in olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Pour in the blended yellow pepper, onion, garlic, walnut and vegetable broth sauce; simmer for 8-10 minutes until thickened.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Serve over the steamed cauliflower and baby spinach, garnished with olives and cilantro.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

meals.name: Brazilian Moqueca-Style Fish & Bell Pepper Stew (Olive Oil)
ingredients: 170g firm white fish fillet (cod, mahi-mahi or snapper), cut into chunks
1/2 red and 1/2 yellow bell pepper, sliced
1/2 cup crushed tomatoes and 1/2 cup vegetable broth
1/2 tsp sweet paprika and ground cumin
1.5 tbsp fresh lime juice and 1/3 cup chopped cilantro
instructions: Marinate the fish chunks with half the lime juice and garlic for 5 minutes.
In a deep skillet, sauté the onion, bell peppers, remaining garlic, paprika and cumin in olive oil for 4 minutes, then add the crushed tomatoes and broth.
Nestle the fish chunks into the simmering sauce, cover and cook for 7-8 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Finish with remaining lime juice and fresh cilantro.
safetyNotes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

meals.name: French Provençal Roast Chicken with Ratatouille Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tsp herbes de Provence (thyme, rosemary, oregano)
1.5 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh basil
instructions: Season the chicken breast with half the herbes de Provence and black pepper, and sear in olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes per side.
Add the eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, garlic, crushed tomatoes and remaining herbs around the chicken, then cover and simmer for 12-14 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Garnish with fresh basil and serve.
safetyNotes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
